classification.difficultyReason: Use the fixed volume to eliminate height from the surface-area formula.

content.prompt:
A closed cylinder is to have a volume of 400 cm³.

Show that its surface area is $S=2\pi r^2+\dfrac{800}{r}$.

spec.description: Upright closed cylinder with solid top ellipse and side silhouettes, solid front lower arc, dashed rear lower arc, lower-face centre dot and radius segment. Height h is beside the right silhouette.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder radius r and height h; volume πr²h and total surface area 2πr²+2πrh.
spec.answerVisibility: All diagram features are permanent student-visible givens.

sizing.reason: Restore the source-calibrated full figure height and width; preserve all drawing coordinates, camera, extrusion and native label font size.

answer.worked:
Volume:
$$\begin{align*}400&=\pi r^2h\\\frac{400}{\pi r^2}&=h\end{align*}$$
Surface area:
$$\begin{align*}S&=2\pi r^2+2\pi rh\\S&=2\pi r^2+2\pi r\left(\frac{400}{\pi r^2}\right)\\S&=2\pi r^2+\frac{800}{r}\end{align*}$$
The surface area is measured in cm².
